WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT
    e.EmployeeId,
    e.City,
    COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS customer_count
  FROM Employee e
  JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City
),
rep_stats AS (
  SELECT
    EmployeeId,
    City,
    customer_count,
    AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_avg
  FROM rep_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT EmployeeId, City, customer_count, city_avg
  FROM rep_stats
  WHERE customer_count > city_avg
)
SELECT
  City,
  SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers,
  AVG(customer_count - city_avg) AS avg_above_city_average,
  AVG(1.0 * customer_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer)) AS avg_share_of_overall_customers
FROM above_average
GROUP BY City;
